title: Cork compressing, a bar of sun arriving

tokens.v: Full-bleed photograph, edge to edge, no border, frame or letterbox band. One beat in a bare plaster room: cups worn in place, head tipping a degree into the sound, her right hand just leaving the headband with two fingertips still bearing down on the cork band. Camera at chin height and tilted up 12 degrees, 85mm at f/2.8 a metre out, so the headband arch opens overhead and its cork underside turns toward the lens where it crosses her crown — the cork is the claim here, not the canvas: granulation squeezed shut into dense packed grain under the load and opening into loose pits either side, the turn's edge rolled and burnished from a year of handling, an unlettered woven tab stitched flat into it. The bar of afternoon sun is arriving, not parked: a shutter cranked open off-frame drives its edge up the wall behind her onto her near shoulder, that leading edge soft with lifted dust. Waist-up. Charcoal wool vest over a white poplin shirt, wide slate trousers, black leather loafers, fully dressed, the blunt bob holding its line. Nothing between lens and her.
